title: Require live sales change authorization before every register and lifecycle operation
description: Complete the explicit sales-order exception workflow by removing SalesOrderChangeRequestController.RequiresLiveAuthorization and nullable authorized-scope fallback. Current helper at lines 55-70 skips existing identity/menu/customer ownership checks for missing HttpContext or empty path with missing identity; register/source-options/detail/create/edit/submit/cancel can reach services unscoped. Always use existing SalesOrderChangeRequestAuthorizationRules and current source-order ownership before reads or writes. Preserve immutable source/proposal snapshots, deterministic source/request row locks, draft-only editing, submission freeze, cancellation reason/history and concurrency errors; never automatically apply the proposal to the original order. Adapt existing fixtures with genuine enabled identities, existing menu grants and live master rows, never a request-path/environment/test bypass. Preserve nullable manual drafts where the established business rules allow them. Full original failure logs and explicit TRX/results directories must remain under .ai/logs/<task>; do not stage generated outputs. No schema changes or new permissions. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Every change register/source selector/detail/draft/edit/submit/cancel entry requires current enabled nondeleted identity, existing sales-order menu and current source/customer scope regardless of invocation shape; denied calls disclose no counts, sources or proposal snapshots.

Permitted explicit-source changes retain current source ownership revalidation under existing transaction/locks and status transitions. Denied calls consume no change number and mutate no requests/proposals/source orders or audit history; no new permissions or implicit source reassignment.

Meaningful controller and genuine isolated SQL tests cover missing/disabled/deleted/revoked identity, cross-customer source, empty/populated/no context, permitted draft-submit-cancel, and zero rejected mutations. Preserve original mutation/authorization regressions and safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: SalesOrderChangeRequestController.cs:55-70 explicitly returns false/null authorization scope based on HttpContext/Request.Path/identity. ERP-414 protects HTTP register and ERP-415 atomic lifecycle but this remaining bypass persists. Backlog/source/history inspected; no existing unconditional change-entry task.
